_instructions: Each block is one bouquet on the website, shown in this order (bestsellers first).

To ADD a bouquet: upload its photo into the photos folder on GitHub, then copy a block below, give it a new id (lowercase-with-dashes) and set "photo" to the photo's file name, e.g. "photo": "IMG_3001.jpeg". The website crops it square automatically.
If the automatic crop cuts the flowers, add "focus": "top", "bottom", "left", "right" or "center".
To REMOVE a bouquet: delete its whole block.
price: whole KSh, no commas. occasions: names from the occasions list. Add "bestseller": true to show the Bestseller badge.
Every block except the last needs a comma after its closing }.
